intro: 3 mangosteens come to roughly 70 kcal (estimate). Almost all the calories come from natural sugar in the white flesh.
diet: Absolutely. 3 mangosteens is still a light snack. The only risk is durian season, when mangosteen becomes durian's sidekick and the total calories climb fast. Have mangosteen as dessert or a snack, not as an add-on to a fruit feast.
tips: Set 3 as one serving and keep the rest in the fridge.
Choose fresh mangosteen, not canned in syrup.
Eat it after lunch instead of a sweet drink or kuih.

swap.name: Papaya, 1 big slice (~150g)
swap.why: About the same calories but a bigger portion, and easy to get at cut-fruit stalls.

faq.q: How do I pick a good mangosteen?
faq.a: Pick dark purple skin that's still slightly soft when pressed, with fresh green leaves on top. Rock-hard skin usually means the flesh has gone bad.

faq.q: Is it true the petals at the bottom match the number of segments?
faq.a: Yes, the small flower-shaped petals at the bottom usually match the number of segments inside. The trick works for most fruits.

faq.q: Why do people say to eat mangosteen after durian?
faq.a: It's a traditional practice. Mangosteen is seen as 'cooling' to balance the 'heaty' durian. There's no strong scientific proof, but it's fine in normal portions.
